status.description: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE requires no claims and at least one uncertainty. SUPPORTED requires cited claims; PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED requires cited claims and at least one uncertainty.

claims.description: For INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE this must be empty. Do not make cited claims about missing information or cite unrelated evidence to imply repository-wide absence.

uncertainties.description: For INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE include at least one explanation of what the selected evidence cannot establish; selected chunks do not prove repository-wide absence. PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED also requires at least one uncertainty.
